messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-83472 triggered for alert prometheus.scrape.failures (instance: scrape-proxy-12). Autopage: severity=high. Paging: @sre-rotation, @oncall-ops

pagerduty-bot: PD-83472 created, assigned to oncall-sre, escalation policy: prometheus-ingest. Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-83472

chris: Acking PD-83472. Looking at scrape-proxy-12. I'm seeing `up` false for a bunch of targets.

chris: `kubectl -n observability logs deploy/scrape-proxy-12` shows repeated connection resets and 429s to the exporter cluster:
```
W0325 09:12:14.123 request.go:645] unexpected EOF
ERROR: http2: server sent GOAWAY and closed the connection
429 Too Many Requests from exporter-01
```

lena: hmm, exporter-01 is in the same AZ as the kafka-ingest consumers. Consumer lag spiked ~3x around 09:10. Could be resource contention on that node.

jamal: Confirmed kafka consumer lag on topic `log-ingest` for `consumer-group=prom-scrapes`: 42k -> 210k msgs. Graph: https://grafana.local/d/abcd/prom-scrape-lag?orgId=1&from=now-1h

maria: We also got duplicate pagerbot messages — autopage retried PD-83472 twice after the initial page timed out. Looks like ack-timeout race: pagerbot sent page, PD didn't register ack, autopage retriggered at +2m.

incidentbot: autopage: retrigger count=2 for alert prometheus.scrape.failures (PD-83472). Suppressing further retriggers for 10m.

chris: Good to suppress. For mitigation: I'm going to cordon scrape-proxy-12 and reschedule to different node, and bump consumer replicas for `kafka-prom-scrape` to relieve pressure. Doing `kubectl cordon node/node-az1-07` then `kubectl drain` for the pod.

lena: Before drain, let's attempt a quick restart of exporter-01 to see if connections recover. If not, re-route scrapes to exporter-02 using temporary scrape relabel in prometheus-scrape-job.

jamal: Restarted exporter-01 container at 09:16:02. Logs show connection pool warmup, 200s resumed. Consumer lag started to decrease after restart, currently at 85k.

maria: PD-83472 now ACK by chris at 09:17:12. Pager bot shows duplicate page suppressed.

chris: Drained scrape-proxy-12 and rescheduled to node-az2-03. After reschedule, targets regained `up=true` for most services. A few exporters still 503, continuing to monitor.

oncall-ops: Noted some customer-facing dashboards delayed metric updates between 09:08-09:20. Any confirmed customer impact?

lena: Customer impact: internal dashboards updated slowly; external customer ingestion (10% of tenants) had delayed metric visibility. No data loss detected, just latency. Estimated affected tenants: tenant-17, tenant-49, tenant-82.

jamal: Patching a short-term mitigation: enable scrape relabel to exclude exporter-01 for 5m and increase kafka consumer replicas from 3 -> 6. Command snippet: 
```
# scale consumers
kubectl -n ingest scale deployment kafka-prom-scrape --replicas=6
# patch prometheus job to exclude exporter-01
kubectl -n observability patch configmap prometheus-scrape --type=json -p='[ {"op": "add", "path": "/data/scrape-job-relabel", "value": "- source_labels: [__address__]\n  regex: exporter-01:.*\n  action: drop" } ]'
```

maria: Scaling complete at 09:22. Consumer lag trending down: 85k -> 30k in 8m. Scrape relabel applied.

incidentbot: PD-83472 status: acknowledged (chris). Autopage suppression active.

chris: Post-mitigation checks: all `up` except exporter-07 and exporter-09 (both in maintenance; unrelated). No further 429 spikes after relabel and scale.

lena: I'll open a follow-up ticket to investigate root cause: why exporter-01 connection pool collapsed and why autoscaler didn't react sooner. Assigning to infra-reliability.

chris: Quick runbook note: if we see duplicate PD retriggers, do not manually reassign until autopage suppression window ends. It causes paging storms. Use `incidentbot suppress` to prevent duplicates.

maria: FYI PD incident log: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-83472/logs (added timeline entries and actions).

sre-rotation: Taking notes for rotation. Action items:
- infra-reliability: root cause of exporter connection drop and autoscaler tuning (owner: lena)
- observability: add metric for `pagerbot.retriggers` and threshold alert (owner: maria)
- ingest: review consumer autoscale thresholds, consider CPU/backpressure metrics (owner: jamal)
- docs: update runbook for duplicate PD suppression and `incidentbot suppress` usage (owner: chris)

chris: Closing PD incident after monitoring window. PD-83472 resolved at 09:40. If anyone sees regressions ping here. :white_check_mark:
